basis: Saved first-seven-prime version, all 128 marginal atoms; no old atom or sieve reconstruction.
new_object: 128 lag-divisibility patterns; paired support rows with exact CRT masses.
diagonal: All-dividing lag profile copies saved diagonal masses. It receives new joint moment calculation but no mass reconstruction.
new_moments: Convert saved ratios to units Q*r; first moment denominator Q^2, joint product moment Q^3, covariance Q^4. Copy source ratio order; preserve support identities.
reader: Exact rational rectangles and support conditions, weighted support-pair rank/select with abstract mass offset; not numerical residue rank. Cache conditions by lag pattern and exact endpoint tokens.
scope: Periodic truncated prime product only. Positive integer interpretation requires n>0 and n+h>0. No derivative, full-totient joint distribution, omitted-prime bound or current-status result.
